svg.title: Dialect and identity
svg.desc: Dialects are systematic varieties that can express identity, place and belonging. Analyse what features do in context; never describe a speaker’s dialect as broken or intellectually inferior. Register choice adds options rather than erasing identity. Add register choices; never rank a student’s identity or dialect as inferior.
